'''Scraps''' was a [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] and the [[Clone Captain/Legends|captain]] of a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Scraps wore [[Color/Legends|white]] [[Katarn-class commando armor/Legends|''Katarn''-class commando armor]] with red markings.<ref name="Adventure" />

==Behind the scenes==
Scraps [[Armor/Legends|armor]] appeared as a cosmetic option for players in the [[2010]] massively multiplayer [[Star Wars video games|online game]] [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']].<ref name="Adventure" />
